about: Labeler model bake-off, run 2026-08-15 (#220). Eight models over the same 60-case grid, to answer the owner's question of which model should back the labeler. Outcome: MiniMax M3 picked — joint-best score, never wrongly answered unknown, ~40s per 60 calls, about $0.81 per thousand visitors against roughly $5 on the frontier tier.
measuredAgainstGrid: THE PRE-ARBITRATION GRID. Every model failed the same four cases (amb-01/02/06/07), the owner then ruled those four were mislabelled by me, not by the models, and the grid was corrected. So the `expected` values inside these rows are the OLD ones and no longer match eval/family-labeler-grid.json. Kept as the record of WHY the correction was made; it is history, not a current score. The current score is the gate: eval/familyLabeler.eval.ts.
